shots.alt: The Render dialog: a draft of the car on the left with the four Render buttons under it, and on the right its Preset, Quality, Look, Size, Background, Light and Lights in the model.
shots.caption: File › Render… (F9): the draft on the left is what Render draws.

shots.alt: The car drawn by the Line art look: black lines on white, thickest round the outline, the shading in halftone dots and its shadow on the floor in dots too.
shots.caption: Look › Line art: the model inked, to print or colour in.

shots.alt: The Render dialog with Light set to Dark and one bulb added under Lights in the model: the draft shows the car lit by the bulb alone, and the bulb's strength, size, shadows and where it hangs are on the right.
shots.caption: Lights in the model, Add › Bulb, with Light on Dark.
